text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer make predictions about new information. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of a model is measured by its accuracy — how often its predictions are correct. Generally, more training data leads to better models and more accurate predictions.
